definition: a length of about three feet
description: An old-fashioned fabric shop with dark wooden shelves full of rolled cloth, glass jars and a brass chandelier. A smiling young woman in a maroon jumper holds the end of a long blue ribbon of fabric to the tip of her nose and stretches her other arm out straight to measure it to her fingertips. A young man at the counter, beside a navy bolt of cloth and a long wooden measuring stick, looks up and smiles, then cuts the fabric with scissors while she holds it.

taps.phrase: to wear a dark red jumper
